title: 两支路电流相差 90°：相量图上的直角三角形
statement: V̇_s = 100∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s。支路 1：R_1 = 40 Ω 与 L = 30 mH 串联，中点 c；支路 2：R_2 = 30 Ω 与 C = 25 µF 串联，中点 d。电流表 A 测总电流，电压表 V 接在 c、d 之间。
求 i_1 与 i_2 的相位差、电流表读数、总电流初相和电压表读数。

questions.ask: i_1 与 i_2 的相位关系是？
choiceExplain: 同相要求两支路阻抗角相等；这里一条感性（+36.87°）、一条容性（−53.13°）。
超前、滞后弄反了：感性支路的电流滞后电压，容性支路的电流超前电压。
无源支路的阻抗角都在 −90° ~ +90° 之间，两支路电流的相位差小于 180°，不可能反相。

questions.ask: 电流表 A 的读数 = ?
总电流 i 的初相 = ?
电压表 V 的读数 V_cd = ?

hints: 两条支路都接在 V̇_s 上，分别求 İ_1 = V̇_s/Z_1、İ_2 = V̇_s/Z_2（X_L = 30 Ω，X_C = 40 Ω）。
相位差为 90° 的两个相量相加或相减，模用勾股定理。
V̇_c 是 L 上的电压，V̇_d 是 C 上的电压（都对底边）；V̇_cd = V̇_c − V̇_d。

en.title: Branch currents 90° apart: right triangles in the phasor diagram
statement: V̇_s = 100∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s. Branch 1: R_1 = 40 Ω in series with L = 30 mH, midpoint c; branch 2: R_2 = 30 Ω in series with C = 25 µF, midpoint d. Ammeter A measures the total current and voltmeter V is connected between c and d.
Find the phase difference between i_1 and i_2, the ammeter reading, the initial phase of the total current and the voltmeter reading.

questions.ask: How are i_1 and i_2 related in phase?
choiceExplain: In phase would need equal impedance angles; here one branch is inductive (+36.87°) and the other capacitive (−53.13°).
Lead and lag are swapped: the current of an inductive branch lags the voltage, that of a capacitive branch leads it.
Passive branches have impedance angles between −90° and +90°, so two branch currents differ by less than 180° and cannot be in antiphase.

questions.explain: İ = İ_1 + İ_2 with equal, perpendicular phasors: I = √(2² + 2²) = 2√2 ≈ 2.828 A (not 4 A).

questions.ask: Initial phase of the total current i = ?
questions.explain: İ = (1.6 − j1.2) + (1.2 + j1.6) = 2.8 + j0.4 A, angle arctan(0.4/2.8) = 8.13° (also the average of the two angles, (−36.87° + 53.13°)/2).
V̇_c = jX_L·İ_1 = 60∠53.13° V and V̇_d = −jX_C·İ_2 = 80∠−36.87° V are perpendicular: V_cd = |V̇_c − V̇_d| = √(60² + 80²) = 100 V.

hints: Both branches are across V̇_s: İ_1 = V̇_s/Z_1, İ_2 = V̇_s/Z_2 (X_L = 30 Ω, X_C = 40 Ω).
When two phasors are 90° apart, the magnitude of their sum or difference follows from Pythagoras.
V̇_c is the voltage across L and V̇_d the voltage across C (both to the bottom node); V̇_cd = V̇_c − V̇_d.
